title: Cabinet approves health coverage for all senior citizens aged 70 years and above under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
ministry_owner: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: The Union Cabinet approved expansion of Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana to all senior citizens aged 70 years and above. PM-JAY provides health insurance cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization, positioning the expansion as a step toward wider health protection.
key_claims: PM-JAY was launched in 2018 as part of Ayushman Bharat.
The 2024 expansion extends scheme eligibility to all senior citizens aged 70 years and above.
The scheme offers health cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for hospitalization.
Implementation continues to depend on state-level execution and hospital empanelment.
